What We Have Studied This Semester
Prefix Suffix Idioms/Phrasal Verbs
They can all be used to help paraphrase sentences.

Words with Prefixes
• Original Text:
If ICT students do not pass the exam, they have to do the course again.
• Paraphrased Text:
ICT students would have to redo the course if they fail the exam.
Instead of “have to do (something) again ” you can shorten it to the noun prefix word “redo.”

More examples of Paraphrasing with Prefixes
• I could not complete the code for my script on Python because my computer was not
working.
=> Since my computer was malfunctioning, I was unable to finish adding all the
code to my script on Python.
• Knowing how to play an instrument is not important when it comes to being a
professional mime.
ÞAs an accomplished mime, having the knowledge to play an instrument is
irrelevant.

Words with Noun Suffixes
• Original Text:
The man from the village who bakes the most delicious muffins wants to open another
store downtown.
• Paraphrased Text:
The baker, who lives in the village, makes the tastiest muffins and plans on opening
a new store downtown.
Instead of “the man who bakes” you can shorten it to the noun suffix word “baker.”

More examples of Paraphrasing with Noun Suffixes
The employee was fired. => The worker was laid off.
The chauffeur drove so fast. => The hired driver was speedily driving.
The person who cuts hair is very good. => The barber is talented.
Beyonce had people dancing in the background during her concert. =>
While performing at her concert, Beyonce had dancers behind her on stage.
Because he is a man who studies animals, he can identify the different types of animals.
=> He can pick out each kind of animal since he is a zoologist.

Paraphrasing with Idioms/Phrasal Verbs
Original Text:
According to the students, the Reading Skills worksheets are very easy and do not
take a lot of time to finish.
Paraphrased Text:
The students think that the Reading Skills worksheets are a piece of cake and
can be completed within a short amount of time.
Instead of “very easy” you can use the idiom “a piece of cake.”

More examples of Paraphrasing with Idioms &
Phrasal Verbs
After saving the world once again, James Bond is going to relax on a beach in Thailand.
=> Once again, James Bond has saved the world and plans on taking it easy on a beach
somewhere in Thailand.
The child broke her mom’s favorite porcelain doll by accident and will have to face the
consequences of her actions when her mother gets home.
=> The child will have to face the music when her mother arrives home for accidentally
breaking her mother’s most treasured porcelain dill.
The ICT students are eagerly anticipating summer vacation. => The students from the
Faculty of ICT are looking forward to their summer holiday.
